Thanks for the forward, Lukas. Reviewed the paperwork quickly — overall looks fine, a couple of items to confirm before we activate: 

1) Tax & entity
- The W9 lists "Helix Systems, Inc." and EIN looks consistent. No red flags in the W9. I will run a quick TXN validation but expect clear.

2) Remit address vs legal address
- The intake shows a separate remit address (accounts payable PO Box). For the vendor master we typically keep the legal HQ as the legal_name/registered_address and remit_address as the invoice destination. Marissa, is that how you want it entered?

3) PO routing preference
- Helix noted three options. For speed of processing I'd recommend mapping this account to "Email-to-AP" with PO owner set to "Vendor AP Email". That way POs generated from Redwood will include ap@helixsys.com and invoices will route via that mailbox.

4) Payment methods
- We need confirmation whether they prefer ACH (we'll need an ACH form) or wire. Samantha, can you confirm if ACH is acceptable and if you can provide bank details when required (we can do secure upload)?

5) Contacts
- The contact sheet looks good. Please confirm a primary invoice contact and an escalation contact for missing PO matches.

If the external confirms ACH/contacts, I'll mark the record for activation and provide the vendor code back to Lukas to create the PO mapping in our ERP.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
AP Manager — Redwood Inference
kbpark@redwood.com
